recentItems.title: TSA's new program lets non-ticketed visitors through security at Mesa Gateway
recentItems.description: The new program, "Gateside by TSA PreCheck," allows approved, non-ticketed visitors to go through security and accompany family members or friends to their gates.

recentItems.title: Tempe Healing Field for volunteers for 25th 9/11 anniversary
recentItems.description: Nearly 3,000 flags will fill Tempe Beach Park this week to honor those killed on 9/11. Organizers need volunteers to help put them up and take them down.

recentItems.title: Trail supervisor urged the North Kaibab Trail be closed before deadly flooding
recentItems.description: The supervisor in charge of the Grand Canyon's trails recommended that the trail be closed for the 2026 season.

recentItems.title: Valley rideshare driver in critical condition after head-on crash
recentItems.description: Phoenix police said the other driver crossed into the opposite lanes of traffic before the head-on collision.

recentItems.title: No plane ticket? You can still get past security at Mesa Gateway.
recentItems.description: Mesa Gateway is one of 13 airports testing a TSA program allowing visitors to go through security without a plane ticket, reminiscent of pre-9/11 travel norms.

recentItems.title: Volunteers needed for 9/11 Healing Field in Tempe
recentItems.description: Nearly 3,000 flags will fill Tempe Beach Park this week to honor those killed on 9/11. Organizers need volunteers to help put them up and take them down.

recentItems.title: Sparky does 385 pushups, Arizona State wins 70-7 in season opener
recentItems.description: Sparky does 385 pushups, ASU beats Morgan State 70-7 in season opener.

recentItems.title: Phoenix police investigate crash that left one person seriously hurt
recentItems.description: A man, identified as a rideshare driver by family, is fighting for his life after another car drove into opposite lane of traffic, according to Phoenix police.
